source_description: The person that has the allergy
The substance that the person is allergic to
target_description: Code that identifies the allergy or intolerance
comment: Extensible binding to BeAllergyIntoleranceCode. For medication allergies use CNK, ATC or CTI-extended. Free text only in code.text when no code applies.

source_description: The category of the risk (food, medication, environment, biological...)
comment: Not captured by the recorder; may be derived from the SNOMED CT concept in code.

source_description: The type - whether it is an allergy or intolerance
comment: Core AllergyIntolerance.type is prohibited (0..0) in the profile. The value is carried in the BeExtAllergyType extension (CodeableConcept bound to BeVSAllergyIntoleranceType) to be replaced by the R5 cross-version extension. When the type cannot be determined, use 'intolerance' with verificationStatus = unconfirmed.

source_description: The status of the allergy - if it is active or resolved
comment: Mandatory in the model when status is present; in FHIR it SHALL be absent when verificationStatus is entered-in-error (ait-2).

source_description: The verification status of the allergy - if it is confirmed or suspected or refuted

target_description: Date first version of the resource instance was recorded
comment: Mandatory (1..1) in both model and profile.
Restricted to Reference(BePractitioner | BePractitionerRole | BePatient). This is the KMEHR 'author'.

target_description: Source of the information about the allergy
comment: Patient, practitioner or RelatedPerson. For family members or other non-professionals only the relationship role is recorded (GDPR). Not the KMEHR 'author'.

source_description: Additional text note about the allergy or intolerance
comment: The model allows one note; FHIR allows 0..* Annotation. Senders SHOULD send at most one note.

source_description: Known past reactions to the allergen
target_description: Adverse reaction events linked to exposure to substance
Clinical symptoms/signs associated with the event
comment: Constrained to 1..1 in the profile. Extensible binding to be-riskmanifestation (SNOMED CT preferred outside the value set).
The model mentions approximate dates (age, period, interval) but reaction.onset is dateTime: only partial dates (YYYY or YYYY-MM) can express imprecision.

source_description: Additional text note about the allergic reaction
comment: Not must-support in the profile; prefer AllergyIntolerance.note.
